num.note: required: the section's number, rendered verbatim in its own column and hidden from assistive technology (RFC §3.1, §7 Q2, Q9). Two digits by product convention; the product computes it, the component never formats it

title.note: required: the heading text, rendered inside the one h2; may hold an <em>, rendered italic in the live accent (§7 Q8); wraps freely (§7 Q7). Never an Eyebrow, the number or any label inside it (Eyebrow §7 Q9)

lede.note:
the introductory paragraph under the title, type/body in fg/dim (§7 Q11, Q12); omitted (or empty) → no

is rendered at all

id.note: forwarded to the h2, never to the root, so the product can name its <section> with aria-labelledby; omitted → no id attribute anywhere in the component (§3.1). The section's own anchor id stays on the product's <section>

a11y.semanticStructure: Exactly one root <div class="ll-section-head"> (no role) holding, in DOM order, one <span class="ll-section-head-num" aria-hidden="true"> whose text is num verbatim, then one <div class="ll-section-head-body"> holding exactly one h2 and, only when lede is given, one p (RFC §3.4, §4.1). The heading is always an h2 (§7 Q10) whose accessible name is the title alone: the number sits outside it and is hidden unconditionally (§7 Q9). id, when given, lands on the h2 only. The root is a div, not a header: inside a <section> a header maps to no landmark.
a11y.keyboard: Nothing to do: no interactive element, nothing focusable — no a, button, input or tabindex is rendered by the component (RFC §3.3, §4.2). The aria-hidden number holds text only, so aria-hidden-focus has nothing to find. Interactive content in title or lede is not expected; if the product nests a link it keeps its own semantics, product-side.
a11y.decisions: Contrast is computed by the gate from resolved tokens, never declared here: the title fg/default, the lede fg/dim, the number and the title's <em> accent/default, each on bg/default — pairs already declared in contrast-pairs.json at normal-text (stricter than the large text the 44px number and 32px title need), the accent pair scored once per accent (RFC §4.3). The aria-hidden number is still visible text: WCAG 1.4.3 applies and the declared pair covers it. The underline is decoration (no text), exempt, no pair. The title wraps — no nowrap — and the body column is minmax(0, 1fr) with overflow-wrap: break-word, and the head stacks at a viewport width of 768px and below (--ll-breakpoint-md), so nothing overflows horizontally (WCAG 1.4.10).
a11y.notes: Implemented per RFC §4; this status moves to pass only through the accessibility engine gate, never by assertion.
